caption: 「今晚九點，讓台北知道什麼叫真相已死。」
scene: A dim office at night, a phone screen held up showing a menacing message, a man in a navy hoodie with round glasses calmly staring at a whiteboard covered in red string, tense volunteers around him, harsh fluorescent lighting.

caption: 十萬支深偽影片，同一秒灌進全台北。
scene: Every screen in the office flashing simultaneously with eerie video frames, a young man with messy hair and round glasses recoiling, a woman with a black bob clutching her laptop, cold blue light flooding the room.

caption: 「阿凡……我那筆退休金，攏總予伊騙去啊……」
scene: A video playing on a monitor showing an elderly grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron weeping into steam from a pot, the protagonist frozen mid-motion, his face draining of color, dim warm light from the screen.

caption: 「啥物假的阿嬤？我在這！」
scene: An elderly grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron bursting through a door holding a rice paddle high, two volunteers stumbling behind her, bright hallway light spilling into the dark office, everyone turning in shock.

caption: 「逐家看喔！鏡頭拿過來！給全台灣看！」
scene: The grandmother slamming the rice paddle onto a desk, a young man with messy hair aiming a phone camera at her, live chat exploding on a nearby screen, warm golden light, triumphant energy.

caption: 「伊若欲騙我，早就騙啊！哪會等到今仔日？」
scene: The grandmother pointing fiercely at the camera, the protagonist standing behind her with reddened eyes, a volunteer lowering his head and stuffing his phone into his pocket, blushing, soft emotional lighting.

caption: 「哥，記得幫我吃一碗滷肉飯，要加滷蛋。」
scene: A translucent glowing cyan hologram girl in an oversized white hoodie smiling gently, her image flickering and fading, the protagonist reaching out helplessly, a whiteboard visible faintly through her body, quiet blue light.

caption: 那一碗冒著熱氣的滷肉飯，究竟是等誰回來吃？
scene: Midnight street corner, a small food stall glowing warmly, a bowl of rice with braised pork and a boiled egg set alone beside a seated man in a navy hoodie, steam rising into the dark, bittersweet stillness.
